# Site assets

Everything here is committed and served directly. Renders and models are
regenerated by scripts in `tools/`; photographs are supplied.

## renders/ and models/, regenerated by `tools/render_parts.py`

`renders/*.png` are poster images shown on the page; `models/*.glb` are
glTF binaries for the click-to-open 3D viewer, exported from the same
Blender scene as the matching render, so each part is the same colour and
the same shape in both. Each `.glb` pairs with the render of the same
name. These are fetched only when a reader clicks a render, never on page
load, and so do not affect how fast the page opens.

| Scene | Triangles | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `concept-balloon` | 9 k | 0.2 MB |
| `concept-drawstring` | 10 k | 0.2 MB |
| `concept-duckbill` | 16 k | 0.3 MB |
| `concept-extraction-valve` | 16 k | 0.3 MB |
| `concept-flower-high` | 8 k | 0.2 MB |
| `concept-flower-low` | 38 k | 0.7 MB |
| `concept-twister` | 24 k | 0.5 MB |
| `concept-umbrella` | 26 k | 0.5 MB |
| `flower-low` | 58 k | 1.0 MB |
| `flower-low-section` | 35 k | 0.8 MB |
| `flower-low-vs-high` | 88 k | 1.6 MB |
| `flower-low-mould` | 116 k | 2.2 MB |
| `rig-artificial-vagina` | 8 k | 0.1 MB |

Triangle counts and sizes are the exported `.glb`, after the web-model
decimation `render_parts.py` applies; source CAD is far heavier (see
`tools/render_parts.py`'s size-budget comments).

## Photo rules

WebP at quality 82 and at most 1800 px wide. No people's faces or names
without consent. Add the file and swap its `src`; nothing else changes.
